时笙成功的把摄像师甩了，悠哉悠哉的顺着小路往山上走。

反正后期会剪辑，前面录的那些已经够了，等到了山顶在录一点就行了。

“陆清韵，你等等，等等，我说你就不能少说几句，好歹是长辈，诶诶……你慢点，我今天为了你……江小姐！！”苏宜修埋怨的声音变成了惊喜的呼喊，“江小姐，江小姐，这边。”

时笙顺着声音看过去，另一条小道上，苏宜修穿着西装，正冲自己激动的挥手，那形象，很滑稽。

而他手上拉着的，正是许久不见的任务目标——陆清韵。

哎哟，本宝宝都快把这茬忘了。

时笙从斜坡上直接跳下去，惊得苏宜修下巴都快掉地上了。

这妹纸，运动细胞不要太好。

嗯，和陆清韵正好。

一个运动白痴，一个运动精英，互补，非常完美。

苏宜修看江晚的眼神就跟看儿媳妇似的，就连时笙这么不要脸的，都被看得有些不自在。

“苏先生，陆先生，好久不见啊。”

“哈哈哈，哪有，我天天都能在电视看到你。”苏宜修想要放开陆清韵，但是又怕他跑了，只能拽着他往时笙面前凑，“江小姐怎么会来这里？”

陆清韵余光扫了一眼时笙，眉眼间流转着一股诡异的笑意，阳光穿透小道的绿叶，落在男人四周，映衬得他越发的诡异。

我勒个去，这丫的功力又增加了。

“拍摄节目啊。”时笙眨巴下眼。

“极限世界吗？我把这件事给忘了，极限世界的节目组今天到这里，都怪你陆清韵，不然我还能下山去接江小姐，你说你什么时候能让我省点心，我养着你跟养个大爷似的balabala……”

时笙：“……”

每次看到苏宜修，都觉得画风好和谐。

而且他用词，真的好诡异啊！

本宝宝有点承受不来。

等苏宜修教育完陆清韵，他将陆清韵往时笙身边一推，恶狠狠的警告，“陆清韵，帮我把江小姐送上去，要是你敢半路跑，我保证你会后悔的。”

陆清韵张了张唇瓣，似乎想拒绝，但是下一秒，他抿着唇，眸光流转，笑容灿烂的点了点头。

时笙鸡皮疙瘩起了一身，陆清韵这货好像有点不对劲。

苏宜修离开后，陆清韵站着没动，只是笑吟吟的看着时笙。

时笙不想落了下风，自然回瞪回去。

一分钟后，陆清韵先移开视线，转身往山上走，时笙目光闪了闪，迈着步子跟上去。

Shi Sheng successfully dumped the cameraman and walked leisurely along the path up the mountain.

Anyway, it will be edited later. What I recorded earlier is enough. I can just record a little bit more when I get to the top of the mountain.

"Lu Qingyun, wait, wait, I told you to say a few words. You are an elder after all, eh... Slow down, I am here for you today... Miss Jiang!!" Su Yixiu's complaining voice turned into a shout of surprise, "Miss Jiang, Miss Jiang, this way."

Shi Sheng followed the sound and looked over. On another path, Su Yixiu was wearing a suit and waving excitedly to him. The image was very funny.

And what he was holding in his hand was the mission target whom he had not seen for a long time—Lu Qingyun.

Oops, I almost forgot about this.

Shi Sheng jumped straight down the slope, so shocked that Su Yixiu's jaw almost dropped to the ground.

This girl shouldn't have too good athletic abilities.

Well, it just matches Lu Qingyun.

A sports idiot, a sports elite, complementary, perfect.

Su Yixiu looked at Jiang Wan as if he were looking at his daughter-in-law. Even Shi Sheng, who was so shameless, felt a little uncomfortable.

"Mr. Su, Mr. Lu, long time no see."

"Hahaha, no way, I see you on TV every day." Su Yixiu wanted to let go of Lu Qingyun, but was afraid that he would run away, so he could only drag him towards Shi Sheng, "Why is Miss Jiang here?"

Lu Qingyun glanced at Shi Sheng from the corner of her eye, with a strange smile on her face. The sunlight penetrated the green leaves on the path and fell around the man, making him look even more strange.

Let me strangle it, this girl's skill has increased again.

"We're filming a show." Shi Sheng blinked.

"Extreme World? I forgot about this. It's all your fault, Lu Qingyun, that the Extreme World program team is here today. Otherwise, I would still be able to go down the mountain to pick up Miss Jiang. Tell me when you can make me less worried. I'll raise you like a balabala."

Shi Sheng: "..."

Every time I see Su Yixiu, I feel that his painting style is so harmonious.

And his choice of words is really weird!

This baby can't bear it.

After Su Yixiu finished educating Lu Qingyun, he pushed Lu Qingyun towards Shi Sheng and warned fiercely, "Lu Qingyun, help me send Miss Jiang up. If you dare to run away halfway, I guarantee you will regret it."

Lu Qingyun opened her lips, as if she wanted to refuse, but the next second, he pursed his lips, his eyes rolled, and he nodded with a bright smile.

Shi Sheng had goosebumps all over his body. There seemed to be something wrong with Lu Qingyun.

After Su Yixiu left, Lu Qingyun stood still and just looked at Shi Sheng with a smile.

Shi Sheng didn't want to be at a disadvantage, so he naturally stared back.

A minute later, Lu Qingyun looked away first and turned to walk up the mountain. Shi Sheng's eyes flashed and he followed with steps.
